# Twintiger stylesheets

These stylesheets come from the Twintiger Retirement Planner, a separate application by the same owner, so the
Stock Research Cockpit shares its look (app shell, sidebar, page header, KPI cards, cards, tables, action and status colours).
Cockpit-specific styles live in `../../cockpit.css`.

- License: Apache License 2.0, as part of this project. Copyright 2026 Twintigers. Released with the Stock Research Cockpit
  (the copyright headers of dashboard.css and navigation.css were changed to the Apache notice for this release).
- Not included: the planner's scripts. The Cockpit renders the same markup on the server.
